newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average was off 101.27 points, or 1.2 percent, at 7,960.84, its first close below the 8,000 level since July 21, due to a stronger than expected weekly report on U.S. retail sales.

* Indonesia's Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS) said the country's inflation rate this year was likely to be higher than the previous forecast of six percent if an ongoing drought lasts longer and the negative impacts could not be contained, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index was up 4.78 points, or 0.73 percent, to close at 662.95 points. The index had fallen to 647.17 points in the morning on the weak rupiah.
* The Indonesian rupiah tumbled to a record low against the dollar at 2,667/72 at 0145 GMT on Wednesday from an opening of 2,643/50.
* Cigarette firms and Sampoerna on reports the government had decided to stop the conversion of clove trees into other crops as cigarette makers' demand for the spice was on the rise.
* Commodities related companies Mayora, Indofood, Prasidha and Budi Acid on the likelihood of a prolonged drought.
* Property firms on reports that sales are down because of the central bank's tight rupiah policy.
* Lippo Bank on announcement of a rise in first half net profit.
